Creators

Join the creator roster.

Paid briefs for UK and remote creators, no follower minimum, and the rate and usage agreed before you film. We brief you like a director, not a client, then pay you like it mattered.

Apply by email

Who we are looking for

Five things we cast for.

  • People who use their phone camera like a tool, not just a webcam.
  • Creators comfortable taking direction: hooks, retakes, notes, all of it.
  • A real point of view on camera, whether that is deadpan, chaotic or dead serious.
  • Niches we are always short on: skincare, home, fitness, food, tech unboxing, parenting.
  • Reliability: turning up to the call, hitting the deadline, saying something if it slips.

How it works

From application to payment.

  1. 01ApplySend us a few links to your best work. It does not need to be viral; it needs to show you can hold a phone and a thought at the same time.
  2. 02Get matchedWhen a brief fits your niche and style, we send it over with the script, references and everything you need to shoot without guessing.
  3. 03Shoot and submitYou film on your phone, on your own time, and send us the raw footage. Our editors handle the cut, so you are not learning an edit suite on a deadline.
  4. 04Get paidPayment goes out on a set schedule once the video is approved. No chasing invoices, no waiting on the brand directly.

Pay

What does it pay?

Rates depend on the brief, the usage rights and how much whitelisting is involved. A simple organic testimonial pays differently to a paid Spark Ad with a three-month usage licence. We always tell you the rate and what it covers before you shoot, not after.

FAQ

Creator questions

Do I need professional equipment?

No. Your phone is genuinely enough. What matters is that you can act naturally on camera and follow a script without sounding like you are reading one.

Do I need a big following?

No. This is not influencer marketing: brands are paying for the content itself, not your audience, so your follower count does not decide whether you are cast.

How much creative freedom do I get?

You get a script and direction, but we want your delivery, timing and personality in there too. Directed, not read word for word.

Who owns the content I shoot?

The brand licenses it for the usage window agreed before you film, and we spell that out upfront. Organic-only jobs and whitelisted Spark Ads pay and license differently.

How often will I get briefed?

It varies. Some creators shoot for us monthly, others a few times a year, depending on how many briefs match your niche and availability.

Do I need to be in the UK?

hypjam is in London, but the roster is mostly remote. Most briefs need a phone, decent light and a bit of space to film.
